baseline: base revision with the exact-half machine selection and lowering patch
candidate: baseline plus the x86-64 shift and subtract for multiplication by 31
methodology: Pinned CPU 3. One frozen ZX bundle. The C reference is compiled with cc -O2. Each host compares its output on every invocation with the C digest. Shuffled runner order, 11 samples per round. Medians use the same symmetric 1.5×IQR inclusive interpolated quartiles on samples within each round and on round medians. Indices are zero-based.
